links.comparator_used: Base Llama 3.3 70B model alone (training knowledge only, no retrieval)
links.outcome: Guideline consistency of answers to bipolar disorder clinical vignette queries, rated by expert psychiatrists (3-point scale); preference ratings
links.effect: 110/126 (87.3%) RAG responses rated as correct as or more correct than baseline; fully consistent 80 (63.5%) vs 24 (19.0%); major deviation 10 (7.9%) vs 48 (38.1%); OR = 9.1, 95% CI [5.3-16.3], P < 0.001; RAG preferred in 78.7% of cases
links.tradeoff: Performance varied by vignette, with some errors in both retrieval and reasoning; 10 RAG answers still had major deviation.
links.quote: Ordinal regression showed RAG responses were significantly more likely to be more correct (OR = 9.1, 95% CI [5.3-16.3], P < 0.001), which was consistent across all raters.

design_hint: retrieval grounding on guidelines added to base LLM
